footnote_text: This transaction was affected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted by the Reporting Person on August 11, 2026. || Represents a weighted average sale price for multiple sale transactions ranging from $4.70 to $4.76 per share. The price per share has been converted from Canadian dollars using the exchange rate published by the Bank of Canada on the date of sale or, if unavailable, the date preceding the date of sale. The Reporting Person hereby undertakes to provide upon request to the SEC staff, the Issuer or a security holder of the Issuer full information regarding the number of shares and prices at which the transaction was effected.
